crossRefs.note: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write…
Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus…
according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and…
I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them, and are established in the…

translations.web: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you,
translations.bsb: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking
translations.kjv: This second epistle, beloved, I ➔ now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
translations.asv: This is now, beloved, the second epistle that I write unto you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by putting you in remembrance;
